text: 从工业和信息化部了解到，我国将以制造业为主战场、以应用牵引为主线，推动人工智能产业高水平赋能新型工业化。
text_en: According to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, China will take manufacturing as the main battlefield and application-driven development as the main line to promote high-level empowerment of new industrialization by the artificial intelligence industry.
